question.text: Rekha, a SEBI-registered investment adviser, discovers that information she previously submitted is false or misleading in a material particular. Under SEBI IA Regulations, she must:

answer.text: Wait until the next annual compliance audit to report the discrepancy
Forthwith inform SEBI in writing that previously submitted information is false or misleading in a material particular or that there is a material change in the submitted information
Correct the information in the next renewal application
Inform SEBI only if she chooses to update her advisory disclosures

explanation.text: The Logic: The IA shall forthwith inform SEBI in writing if information previously submitted is found to be false or misleading in any material particular, or if there is any material change in the information already submitted. The Trap: Deferring the disclosure to the next audit or the next renewal cycle does not satisfy the source-stated "forthwith" requirement; the obligation is triggered immediately upon discovery. Note: The threshold is materiality of the information or change, not whether the IA personally judges the issue to be related to advisory services.
